Weather-webcam photograph from SkunkBayweather.com timestamped Jun 10, 2018, 03:56:14 AM, looking across water under heavy clouds at dawn, with a bright vertical streak of light rising into the clouds at upper left. This is the widely circulated 'Whidbey Island missile launch' image taken over Puget Sound, Washington; the streak was claimed online to be a missile launch, while later analyses attributed it to a long-exposure capture of a helicopter's lights. The camera overlay shows weather readings.
text: SkunkBayweather.com  Jun 10, 2018  03:56:14 AM. Temp: 47.7°F, Wind: SE at 4 mph, Gust: 8.0 mph, Pressure: 30.0 in, Rain: 0.20 in
flags: The streak's identity is unverified: circulated as a missile launch but widely attributed to a long-exposure helicopter; neither is confirmed in the image itself

description: Candid photograph inside a gate area at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA), watermarked Politico Playbook, copyright 2018 Politico. At left foreground, a white-haired man in a dark suit reading a tablet or papers is Robert Mueller, matching the widely published July 2018 Politico photo of Mueller waiting at a DCA gate. Several other unidentified travelers sit and stand nearby, including a bearded seated man and three men standing near a Welcome to DCA sign; online commentary attached various claims about who else appears in the frame.
text: WELCOME TO DCA REAGAN NATIONAL. hannel Airports. 037. POLITICO PLAYBOOK. © 2018 POLITICO.
flags: Other individuals in the frame are not identified; online claims about their identities (e.g. that Donald Trump Jr. was at the same gate) are unverified from the image itself
